# XL8

> > XL8 is an AI-powered media localization platform specializing in automated subtitle translation, transcription, and quality control for global content distribution.

Founded by CEO Tim Jung and based in San Jose, California, XL8 offers MediaCAT and EventCAT products that combine machine translation, subtitle editing, translation memory, and quality assurance tools to help media companies, broadcasters, and content creators localize video content across 50+ languages with speed and precision.

## Key Topics

- MediaCAT (all-in-one localization platform)
- EventCAT (live event subtitling)
- AI-powered machine translation
- Subtitle editing and quality control
- Content localization workflows
- Translation memory and term base management
- Frame-perfect subtitle synchronization
- TPN Gold Shield cloud security
- Tim Jung (CEO and Founder)
- Media and sports broadcasting
- Glossaries and translation consistency
- Live event captioning
- 50+ language support
- Silicon Valley AI startup

## Core Products

- [MediaCAT-Editor: Efficient Editing Tools](https://www.xl8.ai/products/mediacat-editor): AI-powered subtitle editor with QC, translation memory, and validation
- [Transform Media Localization with MediaCAT: Speed, Precision, and Simplicity Combined](https://www.xl8.ai/blog/transform-media-localization-with-mediacat-speed-precision-and-simplicity-combined): MediaCAT all-in-one platform with AI transcription and 50+ languages
